$schema_comment: PASS-2 INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION AUDIT. Recorded by session arena/a4ab7faf-affil1 on 2026-11-20. Every observation below was made by directly fetching each submitted URL and recording the final URL and document title exactly as returned. Observations are EVIDENCE, NOT confirmation of submitter intent, and NOT a claim that any submitted link is valid or invalid (status unresolved per FLG-003). Intended-identity fields (submitter statement, Associates tracking report) are null and must only be set from the enrolled Associates workflow. The intended/observed field groups are never merged.

method.tool: Server-side HTTP page fetch following redirects, capturing the final response URL and the document <title>.
method.network: Platform-level outbound fetch (not the sandbox); amazon.com and ftc.gov were reachable.
limitations: The fetch client appears bot-like to Amazon; landing pages rendered as the mobile 'Product summary presents key product information' variant with plpRedirect=mhFallback. A normal browser may land on a different variant of the same listing.
An observation is a single point-in-time event. Other sessions fetching the same links on the same date recorded different outcomes for some links (see discrepancies).
No price, rating, review count, availability, commission or attribution data was recorded: values seen were ambiguous or policy-gated, and must not be inferred.

irregularities.title: Submitted codes are not ASIN-format identifiers
irregularities.detail: All five submitted codes (B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV, B0c8moW59, B0f3GKalj) are 9 characters. Amazon defines an ASIN as a unique 10-character alphanumeric code (source fetched 2026-11-20: sell.amazon.com/blog/what-is-an-asin). The submitted codes are therefore short-link slugs, not ASINs. Where a product page was observed, the /dp/ code is the ASIN-format identifier. Labels that say 'Intended ASIN' on site pages should read 'Submitted code (short-link slug)'.
irregularities.action: Relabel fields; set intended ASINs only from submitter statement or Associates tracking reports.

irregularities.title: Same-date observations disagree for three of five links
irregularities.detail: Pass 1 (session-arena-f10ea853) recorded homepage outcomes for B00hJ57DV and B0f3GKalj and a checkpoint for B02NbDxp3; the crisp/ edition recorded a checkpoint for B02NbDxp3; pass 2 (this audit) observed product pages for all three. Amazon returns different responses to different clients/times. A single observation does not establish a stable destination.
irregularities.action: Repeat observations over time with tools/verify_links.py; treat destination as stable only after repeated agreement and an Associates-workflow test.

irregularities.title: Observed destinations never match the submitted slug
irregularities.detail: In every resolved case the observed /dp/ code differs from the submitted code, so destination_matches_intended_asin is false throughout. Submitter intent remains unconfirmed; no Associates report or submitter statement exists yet.
irregularities.action: Keep intended and observed fields separate; confirm intent only via the enrolled Associates workflow (test one link per product).

irregularities.title: Landing-page variant varies by client
irregularities.detail: This pass landed on the mobile 'Product summary' variant (plpRedirect=mhFallback) for all resolved links. Consumer browsers may land on the standard detail page or an intermediate ad. Exact consumer landing behavior is unverified.
irregularities.action: Operator should click each link in a normal signed-in browser as part of the test-one-link runbook and record what renders.

irregularities.title: Register spans more than air fryers
irregularities.detail: OBS-5 resolved to a wireless meat thermometer listing. The site's air-fryer-only category framing (categories/air-fryers.html, several guide intros) does not cover the full register.
irregularities.action: Request: broaden category naming to 'small kitchen appliances' or add a thermometer category (owners of contested files to integrate).

irregularities.title: Attribution and Special Link compliance unverified
irregularities.detail: Observed URLs carry btn_ref=srctok-... and channelId parameters of unknown provenance. irregularities.action: Test one link per product in the enrolled Associates workflow; confirm destination and tracking report before scaling.

irregularities.title: No prices, ratings or reviews recorded
irregularities.detail: Prices seen during fetches belonged to ambiguous carousel cards and could not be attributed to the observed listing with confidence. Recording them would be inference, so they are omitted. Policy also gates display of dynamic Amazon data.
irregularities.action: Populate only from Amazon-provided tools/data permitted by the Associates Program Policies, with a dated source.

irregularities.detail: data/confirmations.json (status 'verified'), data/products.json (all blank), archive/ copies and the crisp/ edition's data/product-intent.json (status 'observed_only') disagree on schema and status vocabulary for the same links.
